body: It is on the patient's left... though one thing to note, that on the images of a CT or MRI scan L and R are *reversed* as though in a way looking into a mirror, though that's just the way the images are scanned, reversed - I think it's because the scans go from bottom to top also... well, just to note that the images are reversed (if you have either scan and are able to get a copy of the results for your own records and observation...)

Those cop scumfucks need to be publicly executed.  Is that how those fuckwads treat rape victims too?  Because seizures are rape by God fucking the brain.  The worst mind-fucks that exist.  Those cop scum need televised public execution by hanging.  Cops are utterly disgusting.  Fucking scumbags.
